value: AI-assisted point-and-click vore evasion game with a giant shark-girl. Contains a large variety of attacks and interactions with animated vector graphics.

Use the mouse to control a diver and try and get as far as you can without getting eaten by the shark-girl. Hide in schools of fish and coax her into environmental hazards to stun her and gain points. Collect pearls to unlock new cosmetic items for Mako and upgrades for your diver.
